title: [MAIN]-The system throws the error while posting a receipt against a Subcontracting Order.
summary: Fixed subcontracting receipt posting to correctly handle multiple item variants and component lines by improving inventory matching logic and resetting the remaining quantity after successful posting.
key_points: Remaining Quantity flowfield now tracks inventory with variant and component line granularity
Apply Delivery Challan displays correct remaining quantities for multi-variant items
RemQtytoPost is reset after final successful consumption to prevent false shortage errors
Inventory matching in PostSubconComp distinguishes between different variants and components
Receipt posting against subcontracting orders no longer fails with incorrect shortage messages
quote: Remaining Quantity on Delivery Challan Line was aggregating inventory without enough granularity.
